subject.title: Subagent Premature Announce Bug - Model-Specific Tool Call Handling Issues

question: Should OpenClaw ever promote provider-specific tagged tool-call markers from thinking content into executable tool calls, and should that be limited to Qwen/ModelStudio-style provider wrappers?
rationale: Source inspection shows the remaining parser gap, but treating reasoning text as executable tool intent is a security and product boundary rather than a mechanical parser choice.

options.title: Provider-scoped promotion
options.body: Allow a Qwen/ModelStudio-scoped parser that only promotes standalone tagged sections after allowed-tool validation and live provider proof.

options.title: Keep thinking non-executable
options.body: Treat thinking-embedded markers as unsupported provider output and surface a clearer incomplete-turn diagnostic with model/endpoint guidance.

options.title: Shared marker parser
options.body: Add a broader shared repair parser for tagged thinking payloads across providers, accepting a larger security and regression surface.

recommendation.title: Provider-scoped promotion
recommendation.body: Allow a Qwen/ModelStudio-scoped parser that only promotes standalone tagged sections after allowed-tool validation and live provider proof.
